verification.currentAuditResult: Every audited Headhunters variant remains Unknown because effective Illegal precedence is unresolved.
verification.prohibitedProjection: Do not infer Verified or Unverified from provider, title, activity words, CrimeStat, handler override alone, or a lawful/unlawful keyword classifier.

provider.rule: Provider organization identity is separate from reputation faction identity. Use the explicit Contractor string parameter when factionName is absent.

runtimeTitle.rule: Preserve unresolved runtime substitutions as templates. Do not create a static title or search alias from a concrete runtime value without mission-instance evidence.

releaseState.rule: notForRelease and workInProgress remain independent from Contract Verification.

sourceKeyContract.tupleFieldCompatibility: Scintel auditedExactVariantTuples[].offerKey is the v1 evidenceKey field and must be normalized before it is compared with Moonbreaker goldenMissionOffers[].offerKey.

normalization.providerSegment: Lowercase providerKey; replace every maximal run outside [a-z0-9] with '-'; trim leading and trailing '-'.
normalization.offerSegment: Lowercase evidenceKey; replace every maximal run outside [a-z0-9] with '-'; trim leading and trailing '-'.
normalization.runtimeSubstitutionPolicy: Do not use resolved TargetName, Location, or any other mission-instance substitution. Stable evidenceKey and titleRaw are the identity evidence.
normalization.collisionPolicy: Reject a mapping when distinct [providerKey,titleRaw] tuples produce the same Moonbreaker offerKey. Never merge or auto-suffix colliding identities.
normalization.identityMergePolicy: Exact variants may share one offerKey only when providerKey and titleRaw are identical. Family, series, objective template, runtime value, and display-title similarity are not merge keys.
normalization.versionPolicy: Version 1 is immutable. Rule changes require a new mappingVersion and explicit compatibility aliases; an existing offerKey cannot be silently reassigned.

invariantHashTargets.canonicalization: For each target, select the 25 audited source records, sort by contractId, retain the listed fields and matching outcome-edge types, then encode JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, and separators ',' and ':'.

acceptanceGates.requirement: Every released localized title key in this manifest produces one first-class Mission Offer, and every audited Exact Variant is assigned to exactly one offer.
Exact title search returns the matching Mission Offer and does not promote unrelated concepts that only share a Mission Series or family.
Ghost [TargetName] remains templated unless runtime mission-instance evidence is available; no concrete target name is invented from static data.
Verified and Unverified render only from a proven effective Illegal value. Null or unresolved precedence renders Unknown. Keyword inference is prohibited.
Contractor text resolves the provider when factionName is absent, while provider and reputation faction remain separate fields.

Standing bands, required and excluded reputation prerequisites, share behavior, owner scope, branch ownership, and reward scope/amount remain available through the Moonbreaker API and Mission Offer detail.
No Mission Offer row combines payout, reputation, blueprint, region, or release facts from different Exact Variants or Availability Branches.
All four invariant hash targets match their baselines after reshaping, route, search, or UI changes.
Contradictions remain open until a build-matched in-game observation or a newly accepted source build resolves them; they are never silently overwritten.
